name: 2134-batchdecode-llama31-8b-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct -- the ungated mirror of the GATED `meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct`; config.json matches field for field, ~16 GB of bf16 weights
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one node, one GPU
parallelism: tp1 -- no tensor, pipeline, expert or data parallelism
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, hidden 4096, intermediate 14336, 32 query heads over 8 KV heads, head dim 128, vocab 128256, bf16 unquantized
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=128, warmup the first 15%, bounded at 1280 requests with a 900 s safety cap; the server admits at most 128 at a time
workload: `synthetic_text`, single turn, exactly 128 prompt and 128 output tokens with no spread, `ignore_eos: true` and `temperature: 0.0`, seed 42
purpose: An eight-billion-parameter chat assistant serving 128 concurrent users short single-turn prompts with 128-token replies on one GPU.
launch:
# One H100 serving Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct in bf16 to 128 clients at once, 128 tokens in, 128 out.
#
# Flat `key: value` only. This file is read line by line and an indented line is skipped, so a
# nested block silently drops the key and the server starts without it.

# `meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct` is GATED; this is the ungated mirror of it, config.json
# field for field.
model-path: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct

tp-size: 1

# The engine's default at this release is flashinfer, so this has to be written out.
attention-backend: triton

disable-radix-cache: true

# Caps the running batch at 128, and REQUIRED for the server to start: left unset it derives to
# 2048, and the device-side request table sized from that is far too large to allocate. Raising
# or removing this line to get past a startup failure will not produce a server.
max-running-requests: 128

mem-fraction-static: 0.85

random-seed: 42
